mode_text: Long+Short (1x paper) · Exit Arrows evaluated intrabar on the live price (up arrow closes a short and opens a long; down arrow closes a long and opens a short)
live_formula: long: value=units*price; short: value=max(2*collateral-units*price,0); unreal=value-cost; net_if_sold=value*(1-fee)-cost; bh=alloc*price/bh_c0; balance=pool.cash+sum(value)
sizing_text: Max positions 5 · pool sizing · TP $5 / SL $5 · Long+Short · entry filter OFF · Signals: intrabar (live)

rules.entry: Exit Arrow up, evaluated intrabar every ~5 s: close any short and open a long at the live price; Exit Arrow down: close any long and open a short (1x paper)
rules.exit: Opposite arrow (flip) or TP/SL. Short TP is below entry, SL is above.
rules.fill: intrabar: live Binance price at the 5 s poll (max 1 entry + 1 exit per coin per candle, no re-entry in the exit candle); arrows only visible on the closed bar: next bar open
